name: Ooredoo Maldives Data Center (OMDC) 1
notes: Launched in Hulhumale/Male as Ooredoo's OMDC; sources describe Tier III-ready design, flood resistance up to seven meters, colocation services, and Uptime listing for OMDC 1 in Male. Published capacity was not found.

name: Dhiraagu Hulhumale Data Centre
notes: Dhiraagu launched a live facility at Lot 21563, Dhunburigas Magu, Male City/Hulhumale; Dhiraagu states it is the first Tier IV certified data centre in the Maldives and its milestones list Tier IV Constructed Facility and ANSI/TIA-942-C Level 4 certifications. Published capacity was not found.

name: HDC SmartCom Container Data Centre
notes: HDC inaugurated a SmartCom-operated containerized data centre in Hulhumale Phase II to support smart-city/Open Access Network services; sources cite 99.9% availability, redundant cooling/battery backup, and an 80 kW backup generator, but no IT capacity.

name: National Data Centre (NCIT)
developer: National Centre for Information Technology / Government of Maldives
notes: Government D'MADD procurement sought a business-continuity and disaster-recovery plan for the National Data Centre and National Computer Network operated by NCIT at Male; DCD separately notes a government data center was built in the NCIT building in 2005 for e-government workloads. Published capacity was not found.
